name: X3 Acquisition Corp. Ltd. Class A Ordinary Shares
summary: X3 Acquisition Corp. Ltd. (XCBE) operates as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), primarily established to execute a strategic business combination. Its core objective is to merge with, acquire assets or stock from, reorganize, or engage in other similar corporate transactions with one or more existing enterprises. The entity was founded on July 31, 2025, and its principal offices are located in Minneapolis, Minnesota.
